title: Which club will sign Ayyoub Bouaddi from Lille during the 2026 summer transfer window?
background: Ayyoub Bouaddi is a midfielder at Lille.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Official announcements from the clubs involved or confirmed transfer reporting from a major sports news organization. 
  Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the club that completes Bouaddi's permanent transfer from Lille during the 2026 summer transfer window. Transfer negotiations and agreements that remain conditional do not count as completed signings. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The name of the signing club.
